accordion: Panels open to their real height on a spring while their contents rise in one after another.
alert-dialog: A confirmation that rises out of a blur, with the warning icon popping in before the rest.
autocomplete: Suggestions cascade in under the field and one highlight glides between them as you type.
avatar: Photos fade up out of a blur once loaded, and stacked avatars spring apart on hover.
badge: Badges pop in, a count rolls its digits up or down when the number changes, and a status dot sends out one ring each time the badge's text or count changes.
button: Presses spring back, the label lifts away for a spinner while pending, and an arrow nudges on hover.
calendar: One key glides from the old day to the new one, and weeks slide in from the side you turned to.
card: Card parts cascade in, interactive cards lift on hover and sink while pressed, by pointer or by Space and Enter, and an optional light follows the pointer.
carousel: Slides travel on a spring and the active dot stretches into a bar.
checkbox: The box pops as it fills and the check draws itself.
collapsible: Content opens to its real height on a spring and its rows fall in one after another.
color-picker: The picker unfolds from its swatch, the thumb grows while you drag and the colour cross-fades.
combobox: The list unfolds from the field, rows cascade in and one highlight glides between options.
command: A command palette whose rows cascade in, with one highlight gliding between results and pages sliding sideways.
context-menu: A right-click menu that unfolds from the exact point you pressed, with the same gliding highlight as Menu.
date-input: One highlight glides between day, month and year as you move through the segments.
date-picker: A field that opens a calendar unfolding from it, with the selected day gliding to its new place.
dialog: Rises from below out of a blur, then its title, fields and buttons arrive one after another.
drawer: Slides in from any edge on a spring; its grip stretches while you drag it.
field: Labels, hints and errors move together: an error slides in under the field and the ring turns red.
file-input: A drop zone that wakes up when a file is over it, with new file rows arriving one after another.
hover-card: A preview card that unfolds from the link you are pointing at.
image-cropper: The selection springs to a new ratio, handles grow while you drag and the zoom settles on a spring.
input: The focus ring closes in around the field on a spring.
kbd: Keyboard keys that sink and spring back when pressed, one after another for a combination.
label: A label whose colour follows its control's focus and errors, with a small marker that pops in.
listbox: One highlight glides between options and checks pop in as you choose.
menu: The sheet unfolds from its button, or from the pointer on a right-click, rows cascade in and one highlight glides between items.
menubar: A highlight glides along the bar from one menu to the next, and each menu unfolds from its title.
meter: The bar springs to its value, changes colour at thresholds and the digits roll.
motion-style: Switch the whole set between Calm, Springy, Snappy and Playful motion with one setting.
navigation-menu: The marker stretches between items and the panel resizes on a spring to fit each menu.
number-input: Digits roll up or down as the value changes, and the buttons press in.
otp-input: One ring glides from slot to slot, digits pop into place and the slots pulse when the code is complete.
pagination: One raised key glides between page numbers and the range count rolls.
password-input: The text comes into focus out of a blur when revealed, and requirements tick as they are met.
popover: Unfolds from the button that opened it, then its contents cascade in.
preferences: Puts people's choices on data attributes for your CSS, with a switcher whose key stretches to the value and the four motion styles ready-made.
progress: The bar fills on a spring, the percentage rolls and it turns green when complete.
radio: One selection ring glides to the chosen option and the dot pops in.
rating: Stars fill one after another from the left, and the chosen star pops.
resizable: Panels glide to a new size on a spring, and the handle's grip stretches while you drag.
scroll-area: The scrollbar fades in and its thumb springs thicker when you reach for it.
segmented-control: The selected key stretches across toward the new option, then closes up.
select: The list unfolds from the field, one highlight glides between options and the chosen value rises in.
separator: The line draws itself from the centre outward, then its label fades in.
sidebar: An app sidebar whose current-page key glides between items, that narrows to an icon rail, and that slides in over the page on a phone.
skeleton: A shimmering placeholder that cross-fades to the real content, which rises in out of a blur. While it loads the content is hidden from screen readers and can't be tabbed into.
slider: The thumb grows while you drag, the fill springs to new values and the digits roll.
switch: The thumb stretches toward the side it is moving to, then settles.
table: Rows cascade in, a sortable header's arrow turns over on a spring and reports the sort to screen readers, and selected rows fade in. On a phone it scrolls sideways with a soft edge.
tabs: The key stretches across the list to the tab you pick, and the panel slides in from that side.
textarea: The focus ring closes in on a spring and the character count rolls.
time-input: One highlight glides between hours, minutes and AM/PM as you move.
timeline: Events rise in one after another, a finished step's check draws itself and the rail fills.
toast: Toasts slide in and stack, the ones behind shrink back, and they spread out when you hover.
toggle: The pressed surface pops in, and in a group one hover highlight glides between toggles.
token-input: Tokens pop into the field as you add them, and the remove buttons press in.
toolbar: One highlight springs between the toolbar's buttons, and presses pop back.
tooltip: Pops out of its button, and switches instantly as you move to the next one.
tree: Branches open on a spring with their rows falling in, and the selected row's key glides.
trigger-menu: Typing @ or / opens a menu at the cursor, with rows cascading in and a gliding highlight.
waterfall: Request bars grow from their start time one row after another, and nested spans cascade in.
alert: Alerts drop into place out of a blur on a spring while their icon pops into its tile and draws, and when dismissed they fade and fold their height away.
aspect-ratio: Frames that hold their shape and reshape on a spring when the ratio changes, with photos that fade up out of a blur once they have loaded.
breadcrumb: Crumbs arrive one after another with their chevrons drawing themselves, a crumb for a deeper page slides in from the right, and links underline from their start.
button-group: Buttons join into one strip, and a single highlight glides from segment to segment under the pointer or keyboard focus, taking each segment's corners as it goes.
code-block: Lines cascade in from the left, a highlighted line's band sweeps across and follows the highlight when it moves, and copying pops a tick that draws itself.
empty: Empty states arrive part by part: the icon tile pops and its strokes draw, then the title, the description and each action rise in out of a blur.
form: Fields that settle back while the form sends, a submit button whose label rises through sending to a drawn check, and server errors that open in place under the field they belong to.
input-group: Icons, text, buttons and a count around an input or textarea, in one field: the focus ring closes in on the whole group, the count rolls as you type and a send button pops in with the first character.
item: Rows of content that arrive one after another, with one highlight gliding between the rows you can open.
marker: A quiet line in a stream whose rules draw out from its words, with a light that sweeps across it while the work it names is still going.
native-select: The browser's own select in a Keyframery field: each new choice rises in out of a blur as the old one leaves upward, and the chevron dips.
spinner: Spinners pop in where the work starts, then the ring turns at a steady pace while its arc stretches and shrinks, the one part allowed to keep moving.
trace: Steps rise in one after another, a running title has a light passing through it, a finished step's tick pops in and draws itself, and a row opens to its real height with its detail cascading in.
attachment: File cards with image previews, upload progress, retry and remove actions, built on UI SDK core.
bubble: Chat bubbles that grow from their sender’s corner, with grouped messages, reply actions and delayed reactions, built on UI SDK core.
direction: A UI SDK core reading-direction boundary and toggle that mirror content between left-to-right and right-to-left layouts.
message-scroller: A conversation scroller that follows new messages, preserves reading position and counts unread messages, composed from UI SDK scroll area and core.
message: Sender-aware chat messages with avatars, headers and read receipts that arrive in sequence, built on UI SDK core.
questionnaire: A step-by-step form with selectable answers, keyboard shortcuts, validation and progress, built on UI SDK core and its radio, checkbox and input components.
chart: Bar, line, area and donut charts in plain SVG and CSS, no charting library: bars grow from the baseline one after another, lines draw themselves, rings sweep round, and every change of data tweens on a spring. The tooltip glides with rolling numbers, the legend folds series away, and the arrow keys walk the points.
